scene_analysis.scene_overview: A narrow city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with shops and pedestrians, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a modern glass-fronted store and a historic stone-fronted building with balconies and ornate ironwork. The street is paved with cobblestones and has a central pedestrian crossing marked by white lines and a speed limit sign reading '30' in red letters on a white background. A black car drives down the street, while pedestrians walk along the sidewalk, some carrying bags or backpacks. Trees line the street, adding shade and greenery to the urban landscape. The sky above is overcast but bright and sunny.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street are tall and closely packed, with a mix of old and new facades. The left building has a cream-colored facade with stone quoins at the corners, while the right building has a more modern glass front with a flat roofline. Both have balconies with ornate ironwork and potted plants.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with cobblestones, and the buildings feature a mix of materials, including stone, brick, and glass. The left building has a cream-colored facade with stone quoins at the corners, while the right building has a more modern glass front with a flat roofline.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and streetlights along the sidewalk, providing a place for people to rest and take in the views. There are also several trash cans and recycling bins scattered throughout the area.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The street is lined with trees, which provide shade and add a touch of greenery to the urban landscape. Some of the trees have leaves and branches that hang over the sidewalk, creating a sense of depth and texture.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including a large red and white sign reading '30' on the left side of the street, indicating the speed limit. There are also several smaller signs advertising various businesses, including a coffee shop and a restaurant.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking along the sidewalk, some carrying bags or backpacks, while others are simply enjoying the views. There are also a few bicycles parked along the curb.
